info.name: Friendwave API
info.description:
Send an Auth0 access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The first request from a new user creates their account. Successful responses are `{ success: true, data }`; errors are `{ success: false, message }`. Realtime (socket.io): connect with `io(API_URL, { auth: { token } })`. Emit `message:send` { chatId, text } (ack); `posts:watch` / `posts:unwatch` { postIds } to subscribe to live updates for posts on screen; `presence:query` { userIds } (ack → { [id]: online }, chat partners only). Listen for `message:new` / `message:updated` (Message), `message:deleted` ({ id, chatId }), `post:counts` ({ postId, likeCount, commentCount }), `comment:new` ({ postId, comment }), `comment:deleted` ({ postId, commentId }), `reply:new` ({ postId, commentId, reply }), `reply:deleted` ({ postId, commentId, replyId }), `feed:new-post` ({ postId, authorId }), `notification:new` (Notification), `presence:update` ({ userId, online }), `chat:read` ({ chatId }), `typing` ({ chatId, userId }; send `typing` { chatId } while typing).

Generated from the API's OpenAPI spec by `npm run postman`. Set `baseUrl` and `token` in the collection variables. Creating things saves their ids for the next requests.

variable.description: An Auth0 access token (npm run token)
